summary.text: Torrey Westrom is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 12 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Minnesota House of Representatives and works as an attorney, realtor and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Westrom earned a bachelor's degree from Bemidji State University and a law degree from William Mitchell College of Law.
Westrom represented District 11 in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 1997 to 2013.
He assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 8, 2013.
In 2014 he was the Republican candidate for Minnesota's 7th Congressional District and was defeated by Collin Peterson (D) in the general election.
In the 2026 general election Westrom faces Kari Dorry (D); the Republican primary was canceled.
